model: Each review-bubble viewport pass built a Naver LatLng for every candidate. The same restaurant now keeps that object while its latitude and longitude stay equal, so a repeat pass allocates none.

noise.rule: Count is one constructor call per candidate on the first pass and zero on a repeat of the same restaurant objects and coordinates. A moved coordinate still allocates one. Not a sampled heap trace. Relative is unbounded because the after count is zero.
